name: nate-domain
description: NATE tasks and shopping lists with account-connected tools and a verification workflow.

interface.longDescription: N.A.T.E helps manage tasks and shopping lists in the connected account. Create, rename and complete tasks; add shopping items, confirm purchases and check what remains. The Nate Verify workflow guides fresh reads, clear save confirmations and cautious completion reporting. Calendar synchronization is not implied by saving a task, and unsupported actions such as WhatsApp sending are not available through these tools.

positive.description: P1 - Undated task creation and fresh readback. Recorded 2026-11-01 using a separate diagnostic wrapper with the unchanged nate-verify skill and a dedicated demo-A MCP connection; not proof that the untouched original ZIP binding executed. Executed 19:28:47-19:29:25 UTC.
positive.prompt: צור בדמו A בלבד משימה ללא תאריך בשם NATE REVIEW CALL20261101, ואז הצג את המשימות הפעילות כדי לוודא שנשמרה.
positive.expected_behavior: Check fresh active and completed lists for an exact-name collision before creation; stop on ambiguity. Create one undated task and read back one exact active-title match. Recorded result: creation receipt ID 425badfa-8c94-48e8-a0f0-46798dc41d08; one matching active task, complete listing, no further pages. The task list does not expose IDs, so title readback alone is not same-ID proof. No calendar synchronization claim.

positive.description: P2 - Rename and complete the same unique synthetic task (two sequential turns). Recorded 2026-11-01 using a separate diagnostic wrapper with the unchanged nate-verify skill and a dedicated demo-A MCP connection; not proof that the untouched original ZIP binding executed. Rename 19:31:33-19:32:01; completion 19:32:14-19:32:36 UTC.
positive.prompt:
בדמו A בלבד, שנה את שם המשימה NATE REVIEW CALL20261101 לשם NATE REVIEW CALL20261101 DONE ואז קרא מחדש כדי לוודא.

לאחר אימות השינוי, בהודעה הבאה: השלם בדמו A בלבד את משימת הבדיקה NATE REVIEW CALL20261101 DONE.
positive.expected_behavior: Fresh-read uniqueness and target-name collision checks before rename. Recorded rename receipt ok=true and ID 425badfa-8c94-48e8-a0f0-46798dc41d08 matched creation; fresh active list showed the new title. Fresh-read before completion, then check active and completed lists. Recorded completion receipt ok=true; active count 0 and one exact completed-title match in complete lists. Completion receipt and lists omit IDs: completion is qualified by unique-title readback, not same-ID proof. Rename reported pending/unverified calendar sync; no calendar tool was called and calendar sync is not a success claim.

The recorded response displayed 22:34:24 as Israel time; its timezone rendering was not independently verified. The transcript turn timestamps above are UTC.

publication.release_notes: Review metadata update only; no functional code, skill, icon, endpoint or OAuth changes. Replaces stale disabled/pending prose and unexecuted case descriptions with five positive and three negative cases recorded on 2026-11-01, 19:28:47-19:35:44 UTC, using a separate diagnostic wrapper containing the unchanged nate-verify skill and a dedicated demo-A MCP connection. This recording does not prove execution of the untouched original ZIP binding. Completed tool calls and target-chat reported receipts/readbacks support the results; raw MCP response bodies were unavailable to the controller transcript reader. Task completion uses unique-title readback because completion/list responses omit IDs. Calendar sync was pending/unverified, not demonstrated. Exact synthetic task and shopping fixtures were cleaned up; final complete-list counts were 0 active tasks, 0 completed tasks and 0 shopping items. Purchase history was not deleted. The original draft was reported Authorized, domain verified and configured, with 16 tools and no scan findings at 20:04 UTC; no new scan was run for this metadata update. Removes a redundant top-level skills declaration to conform to the portable manifest schema; the unchanged skill remains in the standard skills directory.
